description: Roadside scenery for the biomes. Instanced and tinted per region, so one model dresses several places.

assets.spec: Village house: 5 m wide (X), 6 m deep (Z), 3.2 m walls, ridge at 4.8 m, origin at the ground centre. Model it in neutral greys with clear light/dark separation (walls bright, roof dark): the engine tints each instance with the region palette. <= 900 tris.
Conifer about 6 m tall and 2.5 m across, origin at the trunk foot. Greyscale with foliage brighter than trunk; tinted per instance. <= 400 tris.
Leafless tree about 4.5 m tall with three broken limbs, origin at the trunk foot. Greyscale, tinted per instance. <= 350 tris.
Faceted boulder cluster about 1.6 m across and 1.2 m tall, origin at the ground. Greyscale, tinted per instance. <= 250 tris.
Curtain-wall segment 8 m along Z, 1.2 m thick, 4.2 m tall plus crenellations to 5.2 m. Tiles end to end with no gap. Origin at the ground centre. <= 700 tris.
Round tower, 3.6 m diameter, 8.5 m to the parapet, conical cap to about 12 m. Origin at the ground centre. <= 900 tris.
Headstone about 0.9 m wide and 1.3 m tall, leaning slightly. Origin at the ground. <= 200 tris.
Torch post about 3 m tall. Put the flame in a separate mesh named "flame" with an emissive material: the engine renders it untinted so it stays warm in every region. <= 250 tris.
Banner pole about 4.4 m tall with hanging cloth 1.35 m wide. The cloth should be the brightest part (it carries the region colour), the pole dark. <= 250 tris.
Ridge tent about 4 m wide, 4 m deep, 2.7 m tall, origin at the ground centre. Greyscale canvas, tinted per instance. <= 350 tris.
Broken stone column about 5 m tall on a square base, with one drum fallen beside it. Origin at the ground centre. <= 500 tris.
Clump of marsh reeds about 1.9 m tall and 0.8 m across. Origin at the ground. <= 150 tris.
Mine support post about 4 m tall with a short lintel bracket, placed in pairs either side of the road. Origin at the ground. <= 200 tris.
Paling fence section 2 m along Z and 1.1 m tall, tiling end to end. Origin at the ground centre. <= 200 tris.
